title: Peters homeres for fifth straight game, White Sox beat Rangers 10-4
text:
Tristan Peters hit his fifth consecutive homer, matching a franchise and rookie record, and Brenton Doyle added a three-run shot as the Chicago White Sox defeated the Texas Rangers 10-4. The win snapped a three-game losing streak for the White Sox, while the Rangers continue to struggle on the road with their sixth consecutive series loss.
Tristan Peters homered for the fifth consecutive game to match the franchise record and MLB rookie mark, Brenton Doyle hit a three-run shot and the Chicago White Sox beat the Texas Rangers 10-4 on Wednesday night in the rubber match of a three-game series. to the Yankees in New York earlier Wednesday.
Peters had three hits and three RBIs and Doyle added a run-scoring single. Sam Antonacci hit two RBI singles and Miguel Vargas went 2 for 2 with an RBI. Sean Newcomb pitched three scoreless innings for the win. Jonathan Cannon allowed two runs over the final three innings for his first save since 2024.
Texas has lost of 12 of its last 15 games on the road has dropped six consecutive road series for the first time since it lost eight straight away from home in 2021. that made it 6-2 in the fifth. He and Munetaka Murakami are the first rookies in franchise history to homer in five straight games in the same season. Texas went 2 for 14 with runners in scoring position and left 12 runners stranded.
The Rangers left at least 10 on base in each game of the series and 33 combined. off White Sox starter Sean Burke in the third for the Rangers. Ezequiel Duran added a two-run single in the seventh. MacKenzie Gore allowed eight hits and four runs in 3 2/3 innings. Texas had won nine straight when Gore started.
Rangers LHP Cody Bradford starts Friday opposite Brewers RHP Logan Henderson in the opener of a three-game series at Milwaukee. White Sox RHP Luis Castillo starts Friday against Twins Dean Kremer to kickoff a three-game set at Minnesota.
